title: Copa América 1979: Paraguay
alts: From the archive, Copa América 1979: Paraguay were champions. The final, in Asunción: Paraguay 3–0 Chile.

Paraguay's road to the Copa América 1979 title, in Chile: won 4, drew 4, lost 1, goals 13–7. Group stage: v Ecuador, 2–1; Group stage: v Ecuador, 2–0; Group stage: v Uruguay, 0–0; Group stage: v Uruguay, 2–2; Semi-final, 1st leg: v Brazil, 2–1; Semi-final, 2nd leg: v Brazil, 2–2; Final: v Chile, 3–0; Final, replay: v Chile, 0–1; Final, replay: v Chile, 0–0.

The biggest upsets of the Copa América 1979, with the winner's chance going in: Bolivia 2–1 Brazil, Bolivia 8% (group stage); Peru 1–2 Chile, Chile 11% (semi-final, 1st leg); Bolivia 2–1 Argentina, Bolivia 13% (group stage); Paraguay 2–1 Brazil, Paraguay 15% (semi-final, 1st leg).
The 10 teams at the Copa América 1979, by group in final order: Brazil, Bolivia, Argentina. Chile, Colombia, Venezuela. Paraguay, Uruguay, Ecuador. Straight to the knockouts: Peru.
